ma.getSystemSetting()

Get device settings (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Return Value

Object res

Attribute Type Description
bluetoothEnabled Boolean Bluetooth system switch
locationEnabled Boolean Geographical location system switch
WiFiEnabled Boolean Wi-Fi system switch
deviceOrientation String The valid value can be portrait or landscape, indicating the device direction. (Note: The deviceOrientation obtained for landscape games on iOS clients may be inaccurate. You are advised to use the screen width and height.)

Sample Code

const systemSetting = ma.getSystemSetting();

console.log(systemSetting.bluetoothEnabled);
console.log(systemSetting.deviceOrientation);
console.log(systemSetting.locationEnabled);
console.log(systemSetting.wifiEnabled);
